abstract: The efficacy of ifosfamide combination chemotherapy was studied in 164 patients, 94 with advanced testicular carcinoma and 70 with metastatic sarcoma. Ifosfamide was given at 40-60 mg/kg/day i.v. on five consecutive days every 3-4 weeks together with mesna prophylaxis with 8 mg/kg i.v. being used at 0, 4 and 8 h after ifosfamide administration. Of 70 sarcoma patients 57 were evaluable for response, of whom 49 had received prior chemotherapy. The overall response rate was 46% (26/57) including 3 complete (CR) and 14 partial remissions (PR). Ninety-four patients with germ cell tumours of the testis were treated. Of 16 seminoma patients 15 achieved CR or PR. Seventy-eight patients with nonseminomatous testicular cancer who had received previous chemotherapy were either treated with ifosfamide/etoposide (n = 63, remission rate: 30%) or ifosfamide/cisplatin (n = 15, CR + PR: 33%). These results indicate that ifosfamide alone or in combination is active in sarcomas, seminomas and teratomas and that further studies are warranted employing the drug in first-line regimens.
abstract_ja: イホスファミド併用化学療法の有効性を、進行精巣がん94例と転移性肉腫70例の計164例で検討した。イホスファミドは40〜60 mg/kg/日を5日間連日静脈内投与し、3〜4週ごとに繰り返した。メスナは投与後0、4、8時間に8 mg/kgを静脈内投与して予防に用いた。肉腫70例のうち57例が効果判定可能であり、そのうち49例は前治療を受けていた。全体の奏効率は46%(26/57)で、完全寛解(CR)3例、部分寛解(PR)14例を含んだ。精巣の胚細胞腫瘍94例を治療した。セミノーマ16例中15例がCRまたはPRを得た。前治療を受けた非セミノーマ精巣がん78例では、イホスファミド/エトポシド併用(63例、寛解率30%)またはイホスファミド/シスプラチン併用(15例、CR+PR 33%)で治療した。これらの結果は、イホスファミド単独または併用が肉腫、セミノーマ、奇形腫に有効であることを示し、初回治療レジメンにおけるさらなる検討が必要であることを示唆する。
